summary: Iter 25 (security regression + save-flow verification) PASSES end-to-end. Backend pytest 13/13 GREEN in 15.8s covering: (1) REGRESSION AUTH — super@miracurl.com / Super@Miracurl123 → access_token role super_admin; admin@miracurl.com / Miracurl@123 → access_token role admin. (2) SAVE FLOWS — PUT /api/settings/branding with google_review_url + hours succeeds and next GET reflects; PUT /api/settings/tax {tax_enabled:false} → 200; POST /api/customers {name,phone} → 200 with id and PUT /api/customers/{id} updates; POST /api/staff {name,role,phone} → 200 and PUT updates; POST /api/products with full ProductIn shape → 200 and PUT updates price/stock. (3) SEC-002 Razorpay plan tampering — POST /api/billing/razorpay/order {plan:'half_year'} returned amount 1,000,000 paise; a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature was computed with RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET; POST /verify with body plan='annual' (tampered) succeeded but the returned {plan, end_date} is server-plan half_year with end_date exactly 183 days out — verified server IGNORES client plan; a second POST /verify with the same order_id returned 400 'Unknown, already-consumed, or foreign order' proving find_one_and_update replay claim works. (4) SEC-001 seed no-overwrite — directly rotated admin password_hash in Mongo via motor+passlib to a new hash for 'Rotated@Iter25!', restarted backend via supervisorctl, then confirmed: OLD .env password 'Miracurl@123' → 401 (seed no longer overwrites), NEW password 'Rotated@Iter25!' → 200. Then restored original hash and restarted backend again — sanity login with 'Miracurl@123' → 200. Also verified the ORIGINAL admin hash starts with $2b$ (bcrypt). (5) REGRESSION — /api/billing/razorpay/config returns key_id + test_mode:true + 2 plans; /api/dashboard/reminders returns {count,items}; /api/super-admin/renewals/queue returns 200; /api/settings/tax GET returns {tax_enabled:...}. Frontend (Playwright on preview): admin login → /settings page renders fully (body text 2320 chars — NOT a blank screen), 'Save profile' click shows 'Salon profile updated' toast, hours field persists on reload, restore succeeds. /customers Add Customer → save-customer-btn → new TEST_iter25_ui_cust row visible. /staff Add Staff → save-staff-btn → new TEST_iter25_ui_staff row visible. /inventory Add Product → save-product-btn → new TEST_iter25_ui_prod row visible with 'Added' toast. All UI-created TEST_* rows cleaned up from Mongo at end.
action_items: The user's reported '/settings saving not working — blank screen' is NOT reproducible on preview. Preview /settings loads fully, saves correctly (branding + tax), shows a toast, and persists across reload. If a customer reported blank screen on production, the root cause is almost certainly session expiry (401 from GET /api/settings/branding) crashing the render — recommend adding an axios response interceptor that redirects to /login on 401 instead of unmounting Settings into a null tree. Not fixed here per Fix Scope (business logic).

OPTIONAL follow-up: add an authenticated in-app 'change password' endpoint so operators can rotate admin/super-admin passwords through the UI instead of the current Mongo-shell workaround (SEC-001 seed now permits rotation but there's no UX for it yet).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2374-2399 seed_super_admin — correctly guards on existing user (only re-heals role if it drifted), inserts hash via hash_pw only on first boot when SUPER_ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD is set, marks must_change_password:True. SEC-001 fix is solid.

server.py L2419-2444 seed_admin — same clean pattern: never overwrites existing password_hash, only auto-heals a missing tenant_id link, inserts fresh only if the row doesn't exist. Verified end-to-end.

server.py L1949-1962 /billing/razorpay/verify — find_one_and_update atomically claims the pending record by matching {razorpay_order_id, kind:razorpay_pending, status:created, tenant_id}; a second call finds nothing → HTTPException(400). This is the correct pattern — prevents both replay (same order) and cross-tenant (foreign tenant_id) exploits.

server.py L1967 — server_plan = pending_doc['plan'] — plan is definitively re-read from the server-recorded pending doc and passed to _plan_or_400/Subscription/tenant.plan/tenants.update. Client's body.plan is never consulted after signature check. SEC-002 fix is correct and verified with tampered request.

server.py L1944 — signature check remains hmac.compare_digest (constant-time). RzpVerifyIn still carries `plan` on the wire (line ~1857) — technically it should be dropped to make the intent obvious, but functionally it's ignored. Consider removing it from the pydantic model + frontend payload for cleanliness in a future pass.

Frontend Settings.jsx — 'Save profile' handler at L47/49 is symmetrical (toast.success on 2xx, toast.error on non-2xx with detail from server), and the /settings render does NOT throw on missing branding fields (all `??` defaulted). No blank-screen render path found in preview code.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter25 shipped SEC-001 (seed no-overwrite in seed_super_admin/seed_admin — L2374/L2419) and SEC-002 (Razorpay verify uses server-recorded plan via find_one_and_update atomic claim — L1934). Both are verified. Save flows for settings/branding, settings/tax, customers, staff, products are all working correctly on preview (both API and UI). Reported production 'blank screen on /settings save' could not be reproduced on preview — likely a prod-only session-expiry render issue (see action_items). Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_security_saves.py -v` (~16s, 13/13). The SEC-001 test restarts the backend twice (once with rotated hash, once to restore) — leaves the environment in exactly the same state it started.
rca of the issue: /settings blank screen RCA: not reproducible on preview. Preview /settings renders body of 2320 chars, save works, toast shows, reload persists. Hypothesis for prod: (a) session expired → axios GET /api/settings/branding returns 401 → Settings.jsx unmounted branding form fields → user sees an almost-empty page (only header, no card body) → looks 'blank'. Mitigation: add a global axios response interceptor at app boot that on 401 clears the token and redirects to /login. Verifiable by: log in on prod, wait until token expires (~24h), open /settings → confirm 401 in devtools + empty form area. This RCA does NOT indicate the save API is broken — save API works. SEC-001 + SEC-002 both green — no security bug remains.
